events.title: War in Darfur
events.note: Armed groups in Darfur, including JEM and SLM/A, fought the government. UCDP records the conflict at war level.

events.title: South Sudan becomes independent
events.note: South Sudan separated from Sudan. Figures for Sudan before and after 2011 cover different territory.

events.title: War between the army and the RSF
events.note: Fighting broke out in April 2023 between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF). UCDP records the RSF among the government's opponents in 2023.

limitations.text: UNHCR and IDMC give the same figure in 2023 and 2024
limitations.detail: The two sources report identical numbers for these years, so they are likely based on the same underlying count. They are still shown side by side, never added.
IDMC's new displacements count each forced move, so one person displaced twice counts twice. Compare them with year-end totals with care.
South Sudan's independence changed the territory counted as Sudan.

idps_idmc_conflict.reliability: IDMC's estimate of everyone living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence at year end. Most IDMC figures are estimates.

idps_unhcr.reliability: UNHCR's count covers internally displaced people it protects or assists, so it can differ from IDMC's estimate. The two are shown side by side and never added.
